topic: Mitigation Planning for Human Impacts on Ecosystems
key_concepts: Human activities can have negative impacts on ecosystems.
A mitigation plan aims to address the negative effects of human activities on an ecosystem
A mitigation plan identifies a specific human activity and its ecological impacts.
Proposed solutions should directly address the identified negative impacts.
An implementation timeline specifies when and how solutions will be carried out.
A mitigation plan identifies the persons or resources involved in implementation.
Expected outcomes and success indicators are used to measure the effectiveness of solution
Clear presentation communicates the mitigation plan and allows questions to be answered.
